name: water-works
description: The liquid layer under a load that lasts, on money that was farmed rather than granted — and then the lot learning to run without hands. Hand-farms the 8×8 field through a Chip Kitchen for about a hundred thousand ticks, long enough to sell the 200 items the Corporate Workshop demands and pay for the Fabrication and Hydraulics climb, then lays THE OLD RECORDING’S OWN 17-TILE MAIN, tile for tile — nine west along the headland and eight north up the field’s west edge — drags a two-tile spur off its east end and tears it straight back up (the one RemovePipe the golden set accepts), and hangs a Tank and one piped head off the main behind a Pump. ONE HEAD LIVES INSIDE THE PUMP'S 500 ml/tick AND THE TANK BANKS THE SURPLUS: 1250000 ml drawn over 2,500 untouched ticks, nothing throttled, the tank climbing to 315300 ml. A SECOND HEAD TIPS IT SHORT AND THE TANK PAYS UNTIL IT CANNOT: 2000000 ml over 4,000 more ticks, plan §5's round-robin throttling on 2710 of them, the tank drained to empty. Then the three legs of one wish: the tank topped up by bucket and the second head boxed and scrapped; the kitchen fed, emptied, unjammed and repaired from arm’s length; the field zoned to replant itself; and a Mk2 arm, a belt and a Mk1 arm banking 40000c into a moved Sell Bin with nobody touching anything, before the belt and the second arm come up as unnecessary and the filtered arm posts straight into the bin for 26000c more. Pins the one-ledger flow model, the geometric network ids, and THIRTEEN command verbs — ten of which no fixture in the set accepted before item 139 fixed the coverage counter to count accepted commands instead of attempted ones. Re-recorded 2026-08-18 by scripts/record-water-works.ts, which asserts every beat above before writing: the fixture this replaces described the plumbing and did none of it, because its session ran out of money 76× short and every hydraulics command in it — including that RemovePipe — was silently refused.
